equity.equity_measurement: Coverage by race and insurance is row % among enrolled ARI patients, not population coverage; White is the referent, 'Other, NH' collapsed, unknown race 1.9%. Ratios are hand-computed, not VE contrasts. Access/hesitancy appear only as a recommendation.

notes: VE is a logistic test-negative estimate adjusted for race, age, calendar time and site, and the headline 40% is a pair contrast with unvaccinated children, with the one-dose CI judged against zero. Table 1 chi-square tests are ancillary, and the nonoverlapping-CI significance rule is not counted as a separate test. Table 2 counts are crude with no crude ratio, so unadjusted results are false, and the racial coverage gap is quantified in the Discussion but no cause is named. [review] Race and insurance are reported as coverage strata in a secondary analysis (chi-square, Table 1), so their role is stratifier rather than the report's primary comparison, which is vaccination status in the VE model.
view_issues: Figure description is a photo of a clinician, though the caption describes weekly test and coverage data. Table 1 positive n=387 is 5.2% of N=7,434, not the 5.0% stated; unvaccinated 6,377 is 85.8%, not the 86.0% in the text.
